author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭವ್ಯತೆಯ ಗುರಿಕೊಡಲು ಮುಂಬರುವ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ
ನವ್ಯತೆಯನಿರುಕಿಸಲು ಮನವ ಮಾಡುವರು
ದಿವ್ಯಶಕ್ತಿಯು ಅಡರಿ ಗುರಿಗಿಂಬು ನೀಡುತಿರೆ
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತ ಆನಂದ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: To give the coming generation a noble goal,
people set their minds on bringing in the new;
when a divine power rises and supports that goal,
there is a joy beyond words, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: People work to hand on a noble aim and fresh ideas to the next generation. When a higher power seems to support that work, the joy is beyond words.
